# Which Atlantic Beach?

Version 3.5.0 gives new entries a title and device name that say where the place is, and fixes several details in the card and the sensor.

## Entry titles and device names

- **New entries carry the area and country.** An entry used to be titled "Atlantic Beach Sea Temperature" with a device named "Atlantic Beach", so places that share a name could not be told apart. New entries now read "Atlantic Beach (Florida, United States) Sea Temperature", and the device is "Atlantic Beach (Florida, United States)". The country is left out when the area already contains it. Entity ids do not change. _[#54]_

## The card

- **The card fits into narrow slots.** It used to ask for six grid columns and broke below about 200 px: the chart overflowed and the place name was squeezed into a one-letter column. It now asks for four columns. At 220 px and wider the layout is unchanged; below that the reading wraps under the place name, the stat tiles flow onto a second row, and the chart scales down to 100 px. _[#59]_
- **The reading follows the display precision.** A state of 9.09 showed as 9.09 on the card while Home Assistant shows 9.1 for the same entity. The card now rounds the reading to the precision set for the entity. _[#48]_
- **"Last updated" shows the measurement date.** The line used the time of the last state write, which every Home Assistant restart resets to the restart time. It now shows the date the site reports, for example "Mar 14, 2026", and falls back to the old behaviour only for entities without one. _[#49]_

## The sensor

- **A page without a current reading makes the sensor unavailable.** When the site returned a page without today's value, the sensor stayed on unknown without a message. It now turns unavailable and the failure is logged once. _[#47]_
- **The chart data stays out of the database.** Every update stored the 30-point chart series in the recorder, although the card reads it from the live state. It is no longer recorded, so the history database grows more slowly. The card is not affected. _[#51]_

## Marketplace

- **Filed under weather and alerts.** Home Assistant 2026.11 sorts integrations in the Marketplace by category, and HACS warned about the missing one. The integration now declares `weather_alerts`. Older Home Assistant versions ignore the field. _[#46]_
- **The README names the Marketplace.** The install section describes **Settings → Marketplace** from Home Assistant 2026.11 and HACS before, and notes that only HACS needs a restart after installing. _[#44]_

## Upgrading

Nothing to change after updating. Existing entries keep their title and device name; only entries you add from now on get the area and country. To get the new name on an existing place, add it again and remove the old entry. Clear the browser cache if the card still looks the old way.
